methodology.commission: $0.50 per side per micro ($1.00 round turn)
methodology.fill: completed signal bar; next-minute open; one adverse tick entry and exit; stop-first ambiguity; gap-worse stop
methodology.selection_warning: Account-size comparison was added after prior inspection of the test era; do not call the period pristine OOS.
methodology.uncertainty: Wilson interval plus circular block bootstrap over chronological rolling outcomes

monte_carlo.method: 5-session circular block resampling with full path-dependent account replay
monte_carlo.warning: Resampling quantifies historical path variation; it cannot repair proxy-data or model error.

risk_controls.basis: counts across overlapping 45-session rolling test paths

selected.event_filter: No new entry from 2 minutes before through 2 minutes after scheduled US high-impact releases.
limitations: Dukascopy CFD/index proxy bars, not CME futures bid/ask or queue data.
The 2024+ period has been inspected in prior research and is confirmatory rather than pristine.
Historical execution costs are conservative assumptions, not observed fills.
Most 45-session starts remain unfinished even in normal conditions.
selected.why_selected: 25K has the best verified target-to-drawdown ratio; the three sleeves were selected on development/validation and improve frequency without martingale sizing.

strategy_rules.entry: Marketable entry at the 09:45 one-minute open plus modeled adverse execution.
strategy_rules.setup: At 09:44 NY, the first 15-minute close must move at least 25% of the prior RTH range from today's open and close in the outer 20% of today's opening range in that direction.
strategy_rules.target: 2.0R; stop-first on an ambiguous one-minute bar.

strategy_rules.entry: Marketable entry at the 09:45 one-minute open plus modeled adverse execution.
strategy_rules.setup: At 09:44 NY, the overnight gap must be at least 10% of the prior RTH range, the first 15 minutes must move against the gap, and the close must be in the outer 20% of the opening range toward the fill.
strategy_rules.stop: One tick beyond the first 15-minute range extreme.
strategy_rules.target: 1.5R; stop-first on an ambiguous one-minute bar.

strategy_rules.entry: Next one-minute open plus modeled adverse execution.
strategy_rules.setup: On a completed clock-aligned 15-minute bar, close crosses beyond today's open ±25% of the prior RTH range.
strategy_rules.stop: One tick beyond the signal 15-minute bar extreme.
strategy_rules.target: 2.0R; at most the first valid signal of the session.
